purpose: Six bounded offline pairs of actual smooth-variable-k typed33 exports. One pair per explicit call; never invoke solver/build/GenCase, reparse BI4, import the old analysis script, overwrite retained evidence, interpolate or hide fields.

derivation.scope: Read complete old program and reuse its33 schema, pressure/velocity/material-displacement/stress/passive-density metrics, receipt bindings, energy/domain/necessary saved-scale screens and original half/absolute thresholds. New source is independent, not an import or second raw BI4 parser.

cli: py tests/support/upl_gpu_perm_pair_r1.py --pair KIND --a REVIEWDIR --b REVIEWDIR --a-check CHECKJSON --b-check CHECKJSON --out tests/figures/upl_gpu_perm_actual_KIND_r1 [--half-check PASSED_GPU_HALF_JSON]

cross_c.gates: all257 original5Pa/.005mm; normalized metrics descriptive only

cross_h.gates: all257 original5Pa/.005mm; normalized metrics descriptive only

effect_c.gates: initial all33 fields bitwise identical; option pressureRMS maximum strictly greater than max(.001Pa,10*own actual GPU_half pressureRMS maximum). No5Pa/.005mm or normalized half gate on an option difference

effect_h.gates: same resolved-option-effect rule and same own full GPU half; ON B must be that half's actual fine side

own_half_binding: --half-check is required only for effect_c/h. Require passed pair=GPU_half,variable,512x33x257,original absolute/normalized gates and physical_acceptance=false; bind all half inputs/outputs, its matching variable side folder/reader-check identity, and this exact analysis recipe SHA. Re-read its full257-row CSV, require all original numeric bounds, recompute actual pressureRMS maximum and require exact agreement with its summary. Never use a ULP placeholder or a backend/option comparison as the half. Effects use B=variable and A=constant.

fixed_input_contract.binary: Little-endian uint32[512,33,257], then257 records(actual double time+512x33 doubles). Require exact byte count, finite entire binary, no extra/missing native PARTs.
fixed_input_contract.clocks: actualt_i=i*2^-23,end2^-15; cdt2^-24,hdt2^-25. Step0 initially, otherwise round(t/dt)-1. No interpolation/native metadata rewrite.

law.formula: k=k0*exp((J-1)/((1-n0)*Ck)); natural base e, exact J1 return k0
law.interpretation: Ck2^-13 is a predeclared manufactured response coefficient, not soil calibration or an accuracy-improvement parameter

fixed_input_contract.schemas: Variable CPU SmoothActual reader checks actual public master/schema1/model1/typedCk metadata,6native double J/n/theta/V/rho/k arrays and actual PosDiv sidecar. PrivateGPU has3native J/n/theta arrays and explicitly derived V/rho/k, no CPU model metadata/PosDiv. Constant OFF uses separately immutable DarcyActual reader with old14-column history/completion, not fabricated variable-only fields.

receipt_protocol.check: Require passed matching backend/model/native_frames257/common_columns33/actual solver exit wrapper proof and physical_acceptance=false. Hash check itself, typed completion/all exports, prepared manifest, reader-owned exit0, helper and source-build Entry.
receipt_protocol.solver: Require current-stage fresh completed source_run,selected_input backend/model/XML/BI4/exact clock/257samples; owned original exit0, all257 rawPARTs plus output manifest, actual GPU completion or canonical CPU program build. CPU must declare a new canonical run. Do not substitute old mapped-J/p128 CPU controls.
receipt_protocol.helper: Require actual111-object/110GPU-substitution exact-link helper and reader program identity; SmoothActual+new perm_actual CPP for variable, DarcyActual+immutable Darcy_actual CPP for constant. Source/program/input/outputs are bound; this offline analysis does not relink/rebuild independently.
receipt_protocol.constant_OFF_control: Require current same-dt constant check old_complete_rate_typed33_exact=true and exactly3 byte-identical retained/current entries physical.bin/native_ids.csv/history.csv, rehash both sides. This is an actual source-regression gate, not a new bridge plot.
receipt_protocol.before_after: Hash all used raw PARTs, programs/logs, receipts, initial/runtime inputs, helper author files, source-build and typed exports before use and again after analysis. No missing telemetry/metadata defaults to zero.

unchanged_safety.native: Finite all33/history values, same-ID x(t)-x(0), exactactualtime/zero-basedstep/locked-dt reader gate, signed finite dterror<=1e-14 (negative safe values valid), elasticplastic0/no-load/p0zero/passiveRhop700..3000 and actual float excess.
unchanged_safety.ledger: All131584 rows:J>1-n0,|J-1|<=1e-4,0<n<1,n=1-(1-n0)/J,V=V0J,rho=rhow+(rho0-rhow)/J,positivefinitek(J),relative n/V/rho/k residual<=5e-13 and solidvolume residual<=5e-13. Constant k must be exact k0. J1/theta0/p0/stress0 initial state; material references/initial physical fields must match.
unchanged_safety.energy: Independent all-history kinetic+elastic+conditional pore-energy ratio<=1.1; inherited telemetry sum roundoff comparison64DBL_EPS*N*max(1,maxratio), not exact water mass.
unchanged_safety.necessary_scales: Every saved row current-J cu*dt/h<=.01,current-ki(Kw/n)*ki*dt/(gamma*h²)<=.01,strict positive-k continuous-decay margin>64DBL_EPS*max(rho,rhow). These saved screens do not independently observe every internal force-stage gradient or prove sufficient stability.
unchanged_safety.activation: Full natural max|J-1|>1e-8 and variable max_time[(kmax-kmin)/k0]>=.005. Recompute k ranges from33 values and compare variable history/completion at64DBL_EPS*max(1,|value|) arithmetic bookkeeping tolerance, not a new physical allowance.

pair_metrics.option_effect: Effect is model change, not numerical error/theory error. Require all33 initial bit patterns exactly equal and actual option pressureRMS maximum >max(.001Pa,10*own GPUhalf pressureRMS maximum). Store all difference metrics descriptively; do not apply5Pa half bounds or claim a resolved effect is more accurate.
pair_metrics.descriptive: All33 per-field numeric and bit-pattern mismatch counts including signed zero; stress Frobenius/component changes, material settlement/displacement, passive density and k response. CPU/GPU passive-density paths remain diagnostic; no exactness gate on them.

outputs.fresh: .json/.csv/.png for one declared pair. Reject an existing output suffix; no old four-bridge plots.

outputs.PNG: Lean2x2 actual pressure/material displacement plus original absolute/normalized bounds for halves/cross. For options show pressure effect with resolved threshold and variable k response; never label option difference as half error. Log display preserves exact zero CSV values without smoothing/clipping.
outputs.JSON: Full provenance, gates, independent metrics, per33 exactness, native/derived attribution, actual-own-half binding for options and explicit physical/public/fullcycle limits.
